instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide, eye-level shot capturing a group walking in a park. The scene is set in an outdoor grassy park under bright daylight with lush green trees in the background. The woman in the red dress (R1) walks in the background on the left, holding hands with the smiling girl in the pink shirt and red bucket hat (R2). The girl in the pink shirt (R2) also holds hands with the smiling woman in the mustard cardigan (R3) walking in the center. On the right, the blonde girl in denim overalls and a red bucket hat (R4) walks holding hands with the woman in the mustard cardigan (R3). Three other children in red hats walk interspersed in the line holding hands. Bright natural daylight casts soft shadows, highlighting the warm tones of the park.
